subject: AvaTech security evidence & stakeholder onboarding plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Eric Li <eric.li@avatech.com>, Nina Gomez <nina.gomez@avatech.com>, procurement@avatech.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 13:05 -0700
Subject: AvaTech security evidence & stakeholder onboarding plan

Hi all — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and proposed owners so we have a clear path to pilot readiness: 

Call highlights (5/21):
- Use case: AvaTech will pilot Redwood to power context-aware search in support workflows; target 3k monthly active users for pilot.
- Decision drivers: latency (<300ms p95), data residency controls, clear audit/log access, and quantifiable unit cost.
- Timeline: procurement + security review targeted 3–4 weeks to get a signed pilot MSA.

Stakeholder mapping (as discussed):
- Economic buyer: Nina Gomez (VP Product) — final sign-off on pilot scope and budget.
- Security / technical reviewer: Eric Li — will validate SOC 2 and pen-test artifacts.
- Procurement: Rebecca Park (procurement@avatech.com) — contract and intake form.

Proposed Redwood owners and asks: 
- Marissa Cole: owning procurement / commercial cadence (mutual action plan, pricing band, contract questions).
- Monica Patel: lead on security evidence delivery (SOC 2 package, redactions, pen-test summary, retention options).
- Jordan Blake: project owner + demo logistics.

Requested artifacts (Eric — per call):
1) SOC 2 Type II report + auditor letter (redacted OK).
2) High-level pen test summary (findings + remediation status).
3) Audit/logs retention options and sample retention window policy.
4) Standard data residency and deletion commitments.

Next steps / dates:
- Marissa to send a short mutual action plan and timeline by 5/22.
- Monica to provide SOC2 + pen-test summary by 5/24.
- Proposed follow-up demo for Nina and broader product team: week of 5/29 — please confirm availability.

If you prefer a formal NDA before we share any additional evidence, say the word and we’ll route it through legal.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: none in this message
From: Eric Li <eric.li@avatech.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Gomez <nina.gomez@avatech.com>, procurement@avatech.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 15:10 -0700
Subject: Re: AvaTech security evidence & stakeholder onboarding plan

Thanks Jordan — good summary. Couple quick clarifications: 

- Confirmed: Nina is the economic buyer and will make the final pilot approval. She asked that procurement own contract details but security sign-off is required before any production access.
- Procurement contact is Rebecca Park (rebecca.park@avatech.com) — I’ve looped procurement on this thread.

For evidence delivery we need: 
1) SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is fine) + auditor statement.
2) Executive summary of most recent external pen test (top-level findings, whether any critical/high issues remain).
3) Outline of how you expose audit/log data (types, approximate retention windows) and any live-query options — we do not need raw logs in the first pass, just proof of capability.

I attached our procurement intake form (Avatech_procurement_intake_form.pdf) — please complete the sections on billing entity and contact details.

On the NDA: we prefer to keep things LOE-light — redacted SOC2 + pen-test summary is fine to start. If deeper artifacts are required later we’ll request an NDA.

Eric Li
Head of Security, Ava Technologies
eric.li@avatech.com

Attachment: Avatech_procurement_intake_form.pdf (stub)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 10:12 -0700
Subject: Re: AvaTech security evidence & stakeholder onboarding plan

I’ll take point on procurement and the commercial timeline.

Planned actions from Redwood: 
- I’ll draft a mutual action plan (MAP) and share by EOD 5/22 — will include demo date options (week of 5/29) and our proposed pilot pricing band for a 6-week pilot. Attached: mutual-action-plan-AVATECH.xlsx (stub).
- Monica — can you confirm which SOC 2 artifacts we can share without an NDA and if we have a short pen-test one-pager that’s cleared for external distribution? I’ll tab out the procurement fields Rebecca wants (billing entity, PO/cost center).
- Jordan — I’ll run the price bands with revenue and legal; expect to include a standard pilot MSA + one addendum for data residency.

Also: I suggest we include a single-line description of the mitigation path for any high findings in the pen test so Nina/Eric have confidence we track remediation.

Marissa Cole
Principal Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: mutual-action-plan-AVATECH.xlsx (stub)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Eric Li <eric.li@avatech.com>, Nina Gomez <nina.gomez@avatech.com>, procurement@avatech.com
Date: Fri, 24 May 2028 09:30 -0700
Subject: Re: AvaTech security evidence & stakeholder onboarding plan

Attaching the initial evidence bundle for your review. Per call notes, these are redacted artifacts and high-level summaries suitable for procurement/security review without an NDA. If AvaTech requires raw logs or full test reports we will need an NDA and targeted access agreement.

Included (attached):
- Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2027.pdf (stub) — includes auditor letter and scope. Sensitive system identifiers redacted.
- pen-test-summary.txt (stub) — executive summary of the latest external pentest; includes list of findings by severity and remediation status.
- logs-retention-summary.csv (stub) — sample retention options (7d, 30d, 90d, custom) and export formats.
- mutual-action-plan-AVATECH.xlsx (stub) — Marissa’s MAP (tracked changes from our side).

Short notes:
- SOC 2: controls cover cloud-hosted inference runtime, key management integrations, and monitoring. We cannot share customer-specific logs; we can demonstrate retention and export via screenshots or agree to a live demo of the audit console.
- Pen-test: no open criticals; two medium findings are in remediation with timelines (see pen-test-summary.txt). We can provide a redacted remediation runbook if requested.
- Retention: default 30 days for KV caches / request logs in hosted tiers; Dedicated/Private customers can extend per contract. We can accommodate a 90-day retention plan for the pilot with pricing adjustments.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Marissa to finalize MAP and pricing today (5/24).
2) Jordan to schedule a 30-minute follow-up demo for Nina / product team (suggesting Tue 5/30 or Wed 5/31).
3) Rebecca (procurement) to confirm required billing/legal fields from the MAP and return intake form.

If AvaTech wants an NDA before we hand over any more detailed artifacts, please flag it and we’ll escalate to legal.

Thanks,

Monica Patel
Security & Trust Lead | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2027.pdf (stub); pen-test-summary.txt (stub); logs-retention-summary.csv (stub); mutual-action-plan-AVATECH.xlsx (stub)
